text:
Ravi: dropped a quick pass on the Rollout Inspector microcopy and metrics layout. Main goals: make rollback reasons and traffic deltas clearer when you hover a version. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/rollout/inspector-copy-layout

Marta: looks good. two calls out: 1) the metric label "Error rate" should specify window (5m/1h). 2) the reason tag for automated guardrails reads the same as manual pause. needs differentiation.

Lina: agree on window. propose labels like "Error rate (5m)" and show a secondary small tag "vs baseline" when we compare. For guardrails add short reasons: e.g., "Paused: spike in 5m error rate" vs "Paused manually by Sam".

Alex (A11y): for SR users, state changes must be announced: "Rollout paused: spike detected. Click to view details." Also ensure tooltips are accessible: tooltips must appear on focus and have aria-describedby linking to longform reason.

Sam: implementation note: the inspector should fetch baseline when hovered, but avoid extra requests during quick scrubs. debounce hover by 250ms and cache results per session.

Ravi: microcopy alternatives for the reason badge: A) "Guardrail: error spike" B) "Automated pause (error rate)" C) "Paused by policy: error rate > 2%". Which reads best?

Marta: prefer B for brevity and clarity. C is too technical for primary UI.

Lina: B + show more detail in expanded panel. also add a small info icon that opens the guardrail rule in the policy editor.

Alex (A11y): ensure the info icon has aria-label like "Open guardrail details" and that the expanded panel moves focus into the panel. For the metric label include `aria-live` updates when the baseline comparison value loads.

Ravi: color/contrast: current badge background is muted red but on dark theme it reads faint. Suggest using a more saturated amber for guardrail pauses and red only for destructive actions.

Sam: agree. we'll reserve red for irreversible ops like "Delete deployment". technical note: flagging the badge as non-interactive by default and only making it interactive when expanded helps with keyboard navigation density.

Marta: small UX nit: when multiple variants triggered the same guardrail, show a combined banner at the top: "Guardrail pause for Variant A, B (2 affected)", clicking expands per-variant reasons.

Alex (A11y): combined banner should be focusable and announced as a grouped alert: "2 variants paused by guardrail: press Enter to expand details." Include `aria-expanded` state.

Ravi: done with updates. i'll push a Figma v2 with guardrail copy B, metric windows, and the combined banner.

deploy-bot: preview created for feat/inspector-copy-v2 -> https://preview.redwood.dev/inspector-copy-v2 (expires in 24h)

Marta: i'll run a content pass and then hand off to docs for the changelog entry. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
